title: answer_only
goal: Submit the chosen result without changing its meaning
guidance: Choose the requested answer fields and their scale before calculating. Submit only those fields, without explanation or alternative formulas. Preserve a successfully computed final answer; do not replace it with an intermediate operand at finalization. An explicit output template controls suffixes, list order and decimal width. Do not append unrequested units or recompute a correct result in prose.

title: normalized_midpoint
guidance: Midpoint normalization divides the endpoint difference by the endpoint mean. The monetary units cancel: a question mentioning source dollars does not turn this ratio back into a dollar difference. Use absolute difference if requested or when asking for a difference between unordered endpoints. Keep fraction scale unless a percent is explicitly requested. Use midpoint_submit after binding the two same-definition values; submit its normalized result, not the raw difference or its percent variant.

title: endpoint_growth
goal: Keep CAGR, growth factor and endpoint midpoint change distinct
when: CAGR.*(?:decay factor|arc elasticity)|compound annual.*(?:decay factor|arc elasticity)
guidance: For the requested endpoint growth summary, use CAGR=(end/start)^(1/elapsed_years)-1, annual factor=1+CAGR, and midpoint change=(end-start)/((end+start)/2). When arc elasticity is explicitly defined here as midpoint percentage change and no second economic quantity is given, do not invent a denominator from calendar years or elapsed-time indices. Use growth_submit to compute and submit the three fields in decimal form.

title: paired_period_scope
goal: Use one period mask and one measure for all paired statistics
when: correlat|coefficient of variation.*log growth|growth-based Debt Sustainability
guidance: Create one ordered period list and align every series to exactly that list. Reuse the same mask for every requested statistic; a correlation must not silently expand to every month in the page. For vessels, distinguish number of vessels from net registered tonnage and arrivals from clearances. For growth CV, use consecutive log ratios of the selected levels. paired_statistics validates aligned periods and computes from the declared series; it cannot correct a wrongly selected column.

title: estimated_baseline_z
goal: Use the estimated baseline spread for a new observation
guidance: For a new observation compared with a baseline estimated from prior observations, use the baseline sample standard deviation (n-1), unless the question explicitly supplies or requests population spread. First derive the monthly increases from consecutive cumulative levels. Exclude the target from the baseline. Compute z=(target-baseline_mean)/baseline_sd, then apply the stated one-sided or absolute threshold. baseline_z makes the denominator and test direction explicit.

title: unit_conversion_before_fit
goal: Convert each source column to the target unit before regression
guidance: Read each table's printed unit before fitting. Convert each series separately to the requested unit: thousands to billions divides by 1,000,000; millions to billions divides by 1,000. Similar-looking old and new tables can use different units. Keep a (period, raw_value, source_unit, converted_value) ledger; check endpoint orders of magnitude before fitting. Do not silently use the same divisor for both sources.

title: debt_holder_columns
goal: Separate total public debt from government-account holdings
guidance: Debt-holder table fact: total outstanding, government-account holdings, and public holdings are distinct columns; each may also split public debt and guaranteed securities. Bind the full parent and child header. A series near total outstanding is not government-account holdings. Where categories exhaust the same definition, check government accounts + public = total before calculating growth.

title: tax_anticipation_scope
goal: Restrict TAB aggregation to the named instrument
guidance: TAB means tax anticipation bills, not all Treasury bills or all marketable securities. Filter instrument rows to tax anticipation issues before summing holdings. Then merge subcolumns into the question's named investor categories (life/fire insurance; general/pension state-local funds), apply the threshold per category per requested year, and sum those counts. Do not count the total-outstanding column as an investor category.

title: source_first_compute
goal: Finish a grounded calculation before expanding retrieval
guidance: When the supplied public pages contain the required rows, extract them and run the calculation now. Search only for a named missing period, header or measure. Return a compact computed object with the chosen formula, aligned operands, units and one final answer; avoid producing many alternative answers and asking the finalizer to choose. A missing value stays missing. Use a compatible linked Program when ready; otherwise use one bounded temporary Python calculation.
